description:
Camille Arno, a top-tier Keeper from Seš'qa. He is well-versed in Sarkazian witchcraft and excels at countering it. Though he has apprehended countless dangerous criminals, he has faced repeated setbacks in his hunt for his own blood relative. To protect himself, he maintains a cold and detached demeanor, habitually distancing himself from others, yet he possesses a sincere side. 

Now, he has arrived at Endfield Industries, looking forward to journeying by your side to fulfill each other's long-cherished wishes.
